Navigate to https://www.procurementjourney.scot/index.php/route-1/route-1-introduction then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First assert the Considerations Before Proceeding accordion title is in the sequential keyboard focus order.
Dismiss the cookie banner with Reject using the keyboard if it covers the page.
Open Considerations Before Proceeding with Tab and Enter.
Verify the first question, Are the good/services you are buying business critical?, is visible.
Keyboard navigation: Use the Skip to main content link if it is the first focus.
Then continue Tab navigation until Considerations Before Proceeding, right after the Thresholds link.
With that heading focused press Enter once.

The page displayed the completion message: “You are now ready to begin Route 1 of the Procurement Journey.”
